"""Read only the committed complete dt/8 branch; dt/16 is still running."""
import hashlib,json,os,runpy,time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/Users/b09501028/Downloads/bem2d.jl/Tatva-BEM');OUT=ROOT/'bem/outputs/fem-dt8-window-analysis-20261030';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
os.environ.update(OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',MPLBACKEND='Agg',MPLCONFIGDIR=str(OUT/'mpl-cache'))
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
TOOLS=ROOT/'bem/tools';C=runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS/'compare_extended_fem_windows.py'));BASE=C['BASE'];DIGEST=C['DIGEST']
parent=ROOT/'bem/outputs/fem-window-postrupture-study-20261030/window';fine=ROOT/'bem/outputs/fem-window-finer-study-20261030/window';begun=time.perf_counter()
summary=json.loads((parent/'summary.json').read_text());manifest=json.loads((fine/'extension_manifest.json').read_text());branches=json.loads((fine/'branches.json').read_text());record8=next(r for r in branches['records']if r['factor']==8);receipt=json.loads((fine/'factor8-receipt.json').read_text())
assert record8['chunks']==88 and record8['output_sha256']==receipt['output_sha256']==DIGEST(fine/'factor8.npz')
chunks=sorted((fine/'factor8-chunks').glob('chunk-*.npz'));assert len(chunks)==88 and [DIGEST(p)for p in chunks]==receipt['chunk_sha256']
assert manifest['context_sha256']==DIGEST(parent/'manifest.json') and manifest['original_steps']==230000
paths=[Path(__file__),TOOLS/'compare_extended_fem_windows.py',TOOLS/'compare_fem_timestep_window.py',TOOLS/'compare_float64_contact_history.py',TOOLS/'compare_refined_fem_history.py',TOOLS/'event_observables.py',parent/'summary.json',parent/'manifest.json',parent/'factor2.npz',parent/'factor4.npz',fine/'extension_manifest.json',fine/'factor8.npz',fine/'factor8-receipt.json']
frozen={str(p):DIGEST(p)for p in paths};first,last=manifest['first_step'],manifest['last_step']
records={r['factor']:r for r in summary['records']if r['factor']in(2,4)};records[8]=record8
ref=C['load_branch'](fine,record8,first,last);data={8:ref}
for factor in [2,4]:data[factor]=C['load_branch'](parent,records[factor],first,last,ref['y'],ref['step_id'])
fields,scalars,holds,maxima={}, {},{},{}
start=summary['physical_shear_interval_s'][0];clock8=start+np.arange(1,len(ref['scalar'])+1)*records[8]['dt_s']
for factor,a in data.items():
 clock=start+np.arange(1,len(a['scalar'])+1)*records[factor]['dt_s'];ids=np.flatnonzero(a['scalar'][:,11]>.5)
 holds[str(factor)]=None if not len(ids)else float(clock[ids[0]])
 maxima[str(factor)]=float(a['scalar'][-1,5])
 if factor==8:continue
 fields[str(factor)]={k:BASE['BASE']['COMPARE']['compare_saved_p1_fields']((ref['time'],ref['y'],ref['fields'][k]),(a['time'],a['y'],a['fields'][k]))for k in ref['fields']}
 scalars[str(factor)]={k:BASE['EVENT']['waveform_error'](clock8,ref['scalar'][:,index],clock,a['scalar'][:,index])for k,index in BASE['SCALARS'].items()}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(11,7),constrained_layout=True)
labels={2:'dt/2',4:'dt/4',8:'dt/8'}
y=ref['y'];dy=np.diff(y)
def norm(v):return np.sum(dy/3*(v[:,:-1]**2+v[:,:-1]*v[:,1:]+v[:,1:]**2),axis=1)
for factor,a in data.items():
 clock=start+np.arange(1,len(a['scalar'])+1)*records[factor]['dt_s'];stride=max(1,len(clock)//5000);ids=np.unique(np.r_[np.arange(0,len(clock),stride),len(clock)-1])
 axes[0,0].plot(clock[ids]*1000,a['scalar'][ids,5],lw=.9,label=labels[factor])
 axes[1,1].plot(y,a['fields']['pressure'][-1],lw=.9,label=labels[factor])
 if factor!=8:
  for ax,name in [(axes[0,1],'pressure'),(axes[1,0],'elastic_shear')]:
   numerator=norm(a['fields'][name]-ref['fields'][name]);denom=norm(ref['fields'][name]);values=np.sqrt(numerator/denom)*100
   ax.plot(ref['time']*1000,values,label=labels[factor]+' vs dt/8')
axes[0,0].set(title='Peak cumulative slip: full native scalar window',ylabel='Cumulative slip (mm)',xlabel='Actual shear time (ms)')
axes[0,1].set(title='Whole-interface pressure error',ylabel='Saved-time P1 L2 difference (%)',xlabel='Actual shear time (ms)')
axes[1,0].set(title='Whole-interface signed shear error',ylabel='Saved-time P1 L2 difference (%)',xlabel='Actual shear time (ms)')
axes[1,1].set(title=f'Pressure at last shared saved time {ref["time"][-1]*1000:.6f} ms',ylabel='Pressure (MPa)',xlabel='Contact coordinate y (mm)')
for ax in axes.ravel():ax.grid(alpha=.2);ax.legend(fontsize=8)
fig.savefig(OUT/'dt8-window-comparison.png',dpi=160);plt.close(fig)
assert all(DIGEST(p)==v for p,v in frozen.items())
result=dict(status='completed_dt4_vs_dt8_conditional_whole_window_comparison_dt16_pending',contact_errors_against_dt_over_8=fields,every_fine_scalar_errors_against_dt_over_8=scalars,maximum_cumulative_slip_at_full_window_end_mm=maxima,loading_hold_first_fine_endpoint_s=holds,physical_shear_interval_s=summary['physical_shear_interval_s'],contact_observation_interval_s=[float(ref['time'][0]),float(ref['time'][-1])],contact_observation_rows=len(ref['time']),original_context_sha256=manifest['context_sha256'],factor8_execution_record=record8,factor8_receipt=receipt,source_and_input_sha256=frozen,fitted_time_shift_s=0,all_contact_endpoints_retained=True,all_native_scalar_rows_used_in_metrics=True,plot_display_scalar_points_per_branch=5000,full_event_or_spatial_convergence_verified=False,dt16_gate_evaluated=False,total_analysis_seconds=time.perf_counter()-begun)
(OUT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(fields=fields,scalars=scalars,maxima=maxima,holds=holds)),flush=True)

"""Known leapfrog half-step clock audit; no fitted shift and no new simulation."""
import hashlib,json,os,runpy,time
from pathlib import Path
os.environ.update(OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1')
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path('/Users/b09501028/Downloads/bem2d.jl/Tatva-BEM');OUT=ROOT/'bem/outputs/fem-scalar-clock-audit-20261030';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False);begun=time.perf_counter()
TOOLS=ROOT/'bem/tools';EVENT=runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS/'event_observables.py'));DIGEST=runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS/'run_checkpointed_fem_reference.py'))['digest']
parent=ROOT/'bem/outputs/fem-window-postrupture-study-20261030/window';fine=ROOT/'bem/outputs/fem-window-finer-study-20261030/window'
s=json.loads((parent/'summary.json').read_text());records={r['factor']:r for r in s['records']if r['factor']in(2,4)};records[8]=next(r for r in json.loads((fine/'branches.json').read_text())['records']if r['factor']==8)
source=ROOT/'bem/outputs/fem-source/933ae1f3fe1c634391bdbd316e4efa5dbf0e6d5d/tatva/pmma/dynamics.py';src=source.read_text()
assert 'kinetic = 0.5 * jnp.sum(mass_flat * v_half_new**2)'in src and 'u_flat + dt * v_half'in src and 'velocity_trial = v_half + dt * accel'in src
paths=[Path(__file__),source,TOOLS/'event_observables.py',parent/'summary.json',parent/'factor2.npz',parent/'factor4.npz',fine/'factor8.npz']
frozen={str(p):DIGEST(p)for p in paths};data={};clocks={};kclocks={}
for f,r in records.items():
 with np.load((fine if f==8 else parent)/f'factor{f}.npz',allow_pickle=False)as a:data[f]=a['all_scalar_history']
 assert data[f].shape==(230000*f,17)
 clocks[f]=s['physical_shear_interval_s'][0]+np.arange(1,len(data[f])+1)*r['dt_s']
 kclocks[f]=clocks[f]+r['dt_s']/2
results={};overlaps={}
for f in [2,4]:
 results[str(f)]={}
 for label,c in [('recorded_integer_row_clock',clocks),('known_velocity_half_step_clock',kclocks)]:
  metric=EVENT['waveform_error'](c[8],data[8][:,9],c[f],data[f][:,9]);results[str(f)][label]=metric
  lo=max(c[8][0],c[f][0]);hi=min(c[8][-1],c[f][-1])
  overlaps.setdefault(str(f),{})[label]=dict(first_s=lo,last_s=hi,counts={str(k):dict(total=len(c[k]),inside=int(np.count_nonzero((c[k]>=lo)&(c[k]<=hi))),before=int(np.count_nonzero(c[k]<lo)),after=int(np.count_nonzero(c[k]>hi)))for k in [f,8]})
assert all(DIGEST(p)==v for p,v in frozen.items())
record=dict(status='completed_read_only_known_leapfrog_clock_audit',physical_integer_window_s=s['physical_shear_interval_s'],kinetic_energy_comparisons_against_dt8=results,exact_common_overlap_counts=overlaps,kinetic_clock_formula='t_n + dt_factor/2 for v_half_new after the kick; contact displacement/slip observables remain at t_n',clock_correction_fitted=False,field_clock_or_acceptance_gate_changed=False,source_and_input_sha256=frozen,all_retained_native_rows_preserved=True,scope='P1 interpolation of saved scalar diagnostics within each common time overlap; no unsaved-field or nonlinear energy-stability bound',seconds=time.perf_counter()-begun)
(OUT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(metrics={f:{label:v['absolute_signal']['relative_time_p1_l2']for label,v in a.items()}for f,a in results.items()},overlaps=overlaps)),flush=True)
